sections.heading: 2. What this policy covers
body: This policy covers only the avably.io website and waitlist sign-ups. Avably has not yet launched as a service — when it does, we will publish a separate policy for the product.

sections.heading: 3. What data we collect
body:
When you join the waitlist, we collect:
- your email address (required),
- the type of equipment you rent, the size of your inventory, and how you currently manage bookings — that is, your answers in the form,
- details about the equipment — only if you choose “other”,
- whether you want to take part in the pilot,
- your phone number — only if you apply for the pilot. Without that application, the form will not accept a phone number at all,
- the time when you give consent,
- the language in which you view the website,
- campaign identifiers (the utm_source and utm_campaign parameters in the address), if you reached us through a campaign link.
We do not save your IP address with your submission. We use it only temporarily to limit the number of submissions from one address and protect the form against abuse. The key expires automatically.

sections.heading: 4. Why we use the data and on what legal basis
body:
- Adding you to the waitlist and sending information about the development and launch of Avably — based on your consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR).
- Contacting you about the pilot — based on your consent, if you express such an interest.
- Protecting the form against abuse — based on our legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
We use answers about equipment type and inventory only to understand who we are building the product for. We do not make any automated decisions based on them and we do not profile you.

sections.heading: 5. Who processes data on our behalf
body:
We use providers that process data on our behalf:
- Supabase — submission database — European Union (Frankfurt)
- Vercel — website hosting — European Union (Frankfurt)
- Upstash — protection of the form against abuse — European Union (Frankfurt)
- Cloudflare — DNS and website protection — global network
- Resend — sending messages to you — European Union

We store data in the European Union. Some of these companies are based in the United States, so technical support may involve transferring data outside the European Economic Area. This takes place on the basis of standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.
We do not sell your data or share it with anyone for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: 6. How long we keep the data
body: Until you withdraw your consent, but no longer than 24 months after you join. After you withdraw consent, we delete your submission.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
body: You have the right to access your data, correct it, delete it, restrict its processing, transfer it, object to processing based on our legitimate interest, and withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal.
To exercise these rights, write to admin@avably.io. We will respond within one month at the latest.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (Prezes Urzędu Ochrony Danych Osobowych), ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw, Poland.

sections.heading: 8. Cookies
body: The website uses one functional cookie that remembers the language you selected. It is necessary for the language switcher to work and is not used for tracking.
We do not use analytics or marketing cookies and we do not track you on other websites. If this changes, we will update this policy and ask for your consent before enabling any tracking.

sections.heading: 9. Is providing data mandatory
body: No. Joining the waitlist is entirely voluntary. However, without an email address we cannot add you to the list.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
body: If we change this policy, we will publish a new version on this page and change the date at the top. We will notify you by email about material changes.

banner.text: 14-day trial, no card. No transaction fees, no per-user limits.

hero.eyebrow: The system for equipment rental businesses
hero.titleBottom: and the transfers with one system.
hero.body: Bookings, unit availability, deposits, online payments, courier shipping and your own store website — in one subscription, with no transaction fees. You open the account yourself, by email, and start working the same day.
hero.feature3: A store under your own domain

premise.statement: “Booking” tools stop working at the exact moment the rental actually begins. A sold item leaves the business — a rented one has to come back: on time, ready for the next booking, with the deposit settled. Avably runs that whole cycle, not just the calendar.
premise.feature3: Store, back office and payments in one

tabs.title: Run the rental from booking to return
tabs.item1Body: The availability calendar covers individual units together with their service windows. Even when two people click in the same second, only one booking goes through.
tabs.item2Body: The register keeps every deduction together with its reason. With an online payment the deposit is collected automatically, and the refund takes one button — the money genuinely returns to the customer’s card.
tabs.item3Body: Shipments and returns through a courier broker, PDF labels straight from the back office, and your own delivery pricing calculated into the order.
tabs.item4Body: A yourname.avably.io address is ready right after sign-up. You build the page from ready-made sections in a full-screen editor, the draft stays private, and publishing takes one button. Your own domain connects with a single DNS record.
tabs.item5Body: Customers pick equipment and dates while seeing live availability, and pay by card at checkout — with the deposit collected automatically. The server always calculates the price, the order lands in the back office, and both sides get an email.

video.quote: I run an equipment rental business. I know the weekend with two bookings against one unit and the hunt for who is holding the deposit — Avably came out of that work, not out of a pitch deck.
video.authorRole: founder of Avably, runs a rental business

features.title: Close the whole cycle, not just the booking
features.card1Body: Calendars for products and units, service windows, tiered price lists with a live quote preview, and extensions with the surcharge added automatically.
features.card2Body: Card payment at checkout with the deposit collected automatically and refunded to the card in one click. Avably adds no transaction fees. BLIK and Przelewy24 — being built.
features.card3Body: Shipments and returns through a broker, PDF labels, your own delivery price list and the cost calculated into the order.
features.card4Body: Confirmed, ready for pickup, checked out, returned, cancelled — in Polish or English, under your business name, with a delivery history.
features.card5Body: The separation between rental businesses runs at the database level rather than on screen, and an automated test verifies it on every change to the system.

cta.title: Move bookings off the phone and into a system
cta.body: The customer books and pays online, you see the order in the back office, and the equipment returns to stock with its inspection recorded. No spreadsheet only one person understands.

momentum.title: Open your store in three steps
momentum.card1Body: You confirm the address and you are in the back office. No installation, no waiting on us, no sales call.
momentum.card2Body: Products, units, tiered price lists and pickup locations — as much as you actually rent out.
momentum.card3Body: You turn on the store website, the order lands in the back office, the customer gets an email, and you run the rental through to the return.

faq.a1: Card payment at checkout works — with the deposit collected automatically and refunded to the card from the back office. Customers can also choose a bank transfer or payment on pickup. BLIK and Przelewy24 are being built, and we are not giving dates for them.
faq.q2: I run my bookings in a spreadsheet. How do I move the data?
faq.a2: You load the catalogue from a CSV file, and export works the other way too — your data is never locked in. You can also enter products and units by hand in the back office: with a small catalogue that is an hour of work.
faq.q3: Can the store run under my own domain?
faq.a3: You get a yourname.avably.io address the moment you sign up. Your own domain connects with a single record at your domain provider — the back office shows what to add and checks by itself whether it works.
faq.q4: How much commission do you take per booking?
faq.a4: You pay a flat subscription and that is all — we add no transaction fees and no per-user charges. Your agreement with the online payment provider is your own, so you know its rates first-hand.
faq.q5: Is my data separated from other businesses?
faq.a5: Each rental business’s data is separated in the database rather than on screen, and automated tests verify that separation on every change to the system. Administrative access to the platform is protected by a second factor.
faq.a6: The trial needs no card, so nothing gets charged automatically. After 14 days you pick a plan — Standard PLN 199 or Premium PLN 399 net per month — with no annual contract and no onboarding fee. You cancel whenever you want.
faq.q7: Where do you keep the data, and what about GDPR?
faq.a7: The database, hosting and email run with providers in EU regions. We store ordinary contact details of your customers — no national ID numbers and no document scans. The full GDPR paperwork for rental businesses (data processing agreement) is in preparation — we say so plainly.
faq.a8: The store address works immediately after sign-up, with no sales call and no installation. Time to the first booking depends on how large a catalogue you enter — that part we will not promise in hours.

security.title: See how we guard the data
security.card1Body: Each rental business’s data is separated at the database level (Row Level Security), and automated tests verify the isolation on every change to the system.
security.card2Body: Every response ships with a Content-Security-Policy generated per request (with a one-time nonce), HSTS and a full set of security headers.
security.card3Body: The database, hosting and email run with providers in EU regions. Payments are handled by Stripe — card data never passes through our servers.
security.card4Body: Integration keys (for example courier credentials) are encrypted separately for each rental business, and the encryption key does not live in the database.
security.card5Body: We publish security.txt (RFC 9116) with a contact for vulnerability reports — we would rather hear about a problem first.
security.note: We hold no external certifications and claim none. We describe only what runs in the code and is verified automatically.
